Name: Earthy Seasonal Clover Dig Spot
Author: S4iS3i
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/voYUfwl.png[/img]


[b]This mod recolors the Seasonal Clover Dig Spot by Aimon111 to fit with the color palette from Earthy Recolour by DaisyNiko.
[/b]Each seasons color tones are taken from the leaf and tree textures from Earthy Recolour.[/center][center]The desert color is taken from the cliffs in the desert. The island color is taken from the palm trees on ginger island.[/center][center]The optional beach dig spot shell colors are taken from a purple and pink flower.[/center][center][/center]
[center][b]Compared to the original mod there is another tiny change made.[/b]
There is a bit of blown sand on top of the desert dig spot, and some fallen snow on the winter dig spot.[/center]
[center][/center][center][b]Like the original mod, the 1.6 added seed dig spots are also included and recolored in the same way.[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/FHCpZcr.png[/img]


[b]Install [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16626]Seasonal Clover Dig Spot[/url][b]﻿ with a mod manager or manually.[/b]
